title: Les Miserables
lyrics_synced:
[00:15.39] (Fantine) I dreamed a dream in time gone by
[00:21.31] When hope was high
[00:22.78] And life worth living
[00:27.23] I dreamed that love would never die
[00:33.14] I dreamed that God would be forgiving
[00:39.02] Then I was young and unafraid
[00:45.19] And dreams were made and used and wasted
[00:51.13] There was no ransom to be paid
[00:57.06] No song unsung, no wine untasted
[01:02.93] But the tigers come at night
[01:08.87] With their voices soft as thunder
[01:14.80] As they tear your hope apart
[01:20.76] And they turn your dream to shame
[01:24.41] . . . . .
[01:32.59] He slept a summer by my side
[01:38.49] He filled my days with endless wonder
[01:44.27] He took my childhood in his stride
[01:50.19] But he was gone when autumn came
[01:59.07] And still I dream he'll come to me
[02:05.12] That we will live the years together
[02:11.11] But there are dreams that cannot be
[02:17.03] And there are storms we cannot weather I had a dream my life would be
[02:26.62] . . . .
[02:28.12] .So different from this hell I'm living .
[02:31.64] . . . . . . . . . .
[02:35.28] So different now from what it seemed
[02:40.38] Now life has killed the dream I dreamed.
